text_block_list.text:
—Some time had passed since Phalaenopsis 
and I 
had taken our first steps into the Twinkle 
Series. One day...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—Complacency is a mortal foe. Things have 
grown rather untidy here. 
Carelessness slips in when one least 
expects it.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
We must not rest on our laurels in blessed 
circumstances. 
We must remember where we began, and keep 
this room orderly.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The basics of cleaning are top to bottom. 
The floor comes last. 
First, organize the area around the 
bookshelf. I shall dust. Understood?
choice_data_list:
Right, sorry to make you help. I'll give 
it my all!

Yeah, sorry for making you help out. I'll 
do my best!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... As I thought, quite a bit of 
dust... 
Even if daily is impossible, we must tend 
to it regularly.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
How goes things on your end— 
Hm...?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Hey now, your hands have stopped. 
What are you looking at?
choice_data_list:
Ah... No, just looking at the training 
log...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Ah... From back when we first formed our 
contract. 
Even so—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Reading through it like this... 
Your feelings are palpable in every single 
word.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even after you chose to believe in me and 
run together. 
A blend of fierce resolve... and 
thoughtful consideration.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... And yet, you still pushed ever 
forward. 
The day will come when your efforts bear 
fruit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Even if none can yet foresee just how it 
shall grow. 
Sprouting leaves, branching out wide and 
proud.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, just like that potted plant over 
there—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have taken up houseplants? ...Not a 
bad pastime. 
A touch of vibrant green in a room is 
always welcome.
choice_data_list:
I figured a fern would be easy to care 
for.

text_block_list.text:
Though Phalaenopsis possesses a resolute, 
unyielding spirit, 
she also holds a refined appreciation for 
poetry and flowers.

This plant was an idea born from my desire 
to better understand her unique worldview.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I see. 
Hm...? Look, a new frond is just about to 
unfurl here.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A sprout so tender, yet brimming with 
promise, 
May it flourish until it cascades in rich 
abundance.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ......Keep striving, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Come now, do not daydream all day. 
We will never finish unless you move your 
hands.

After cleaning thoroughly until dusk, I am 
now tackling my work alone. 
Having a tidy room certainly seems to make 
focusing on paperwork easier.

Reaching a good stopping point, I turn my 
gaze toward the houseplant.
choice_data_list: I hope you grow big and strong.

text_block_list.text: I mull over the waka poem from earlier.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“A sprout so tender, yet brimming with 
promise, 
May it flourish until it cascades in rich 
abundance.”

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: “......Keep striving, Trainer.”

—As I recall her parting words, 
something suddenly clicks in my mind.

She recited a poem after seeing the plant 
sprout new leaves. 
Yet the words that followed were directed 
straight at me.
choice_data_list: Could the true meaning of that poem be—

text_block_list.text:
I thought she was simply looking forward 
to a fern's growth, 
but... that wasn't all.

“May it flourish until it cascades in rich 
abundance”... That message, 
wishing for it to grow so lush that it 
cascades—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
“A glorious tapestry where countless 
victories blossom. 
That is the true way to repay my debt of 
gratitude to the Club.”

I couldn't help but feel it was an 
encouraging cheer sung just for me, 
as I set out to stand by her side and 
support her grand ambitions.
choice_data_list:
Only noticing it now... I've still got a 
long way to go.

Only noticing it now... I still have a 
long way to go.

text_block_list.text:
The road ahead is long. But I must become 
someone 
worthy of standing beside her and 
supporting her.

With renewed resolve, I dedicated myself 
to ever greater effort.
